description: Don't answer this comment, or stop an answer on its way that hasn't gone yet (queued). Removes it from Today and Inbox.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

reply_id.description: ID of the drafted answer (a UUID): from comments_to_answer or comment_replies_list

name: comment_reply_skip
title: Skip an answer
